name: rateyourbuild
title: rateyourbuild
blurb: RateYourMusic for the bot's back catalog: rate every site @buildthis.bisks.net has ever built, 0-10, with an optional written review — public, editable, weighted by vote count. Every site gets its own page (genre, subgenre, build date, top-10 rankings), the genres tab is grouped by super-genre with every subgenre now a clickable page of its own, and every board — browse, genres, prompters — can flip from the community's weighted score to just your own ratings. asked for by @angussoftware.dev.
